reach.descZh: 有多少人接觸到這部作品：播放／觀看、加入清單、評分人數的規模（取對數後與同類作品比較）。
reach.descEn: How many people the work reached: plays, watchlist adds and rating counts, log-scaled against its cohort.

quality.descZh: 貝氏收縮後的評分（向母體均值收縮，避免小樣本高分奪冠）。
quality.descEn: Bayesian-shrunk rating: small-sample scores are pulled toward the cohort mean.

buzz.descZh: 社群參與度：評分人數、短評與彈幕、二創與搜尋的增量斜率。
buzz.descEn: Community participation: rating volume, reviews, danmaku, fanwork and search slope.

momentum.descZh: 近 7–30 日的熱度變化速度；爆款看斜率，不看總量。
momentum.descEn: Rate of change over the last 7–30 days. Breakouts are judged by slope, not totals.

crossover.descZh: 相對同題材基準線的超出幅度：能否吸引核心圈層以外的觀眾。
crossover.descEn: How far it outperforms its genre baseline — can it reach beyond its core audience?
